evidence.observation: Pressure was 3.147 Torr at the end of the ramp with Ar at 100.2 sccm.
Growth pressure rose to 3.276 Torr and continued rising at subsequent observations.

Pressure reached 3.526 Torr despite stable growth temperature (750.3 °C versus 750 °C setpoint) and Ar flow (99.8 versus 100 sccm); the sustained pressure rise indicates a process deviation but does not identify its cause.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; oxygen readings are unavailable, so the required growth-atmosphere verification cannot be performed.

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust oxygen measurement is required to verify the atmosphere; expected growth pressure limits, a leak check and exhaust/pumping checks are needed to distinguish causes of the pressure rise. No sample characterization is available.
